press_references.value: Maze Therapeutics teams with Zifo to enhance precision medicine data tools

partnership_announcements.description: Maze Therapeutics and Zifo Technologies announced a strategic partnership in which Maze will use Zifo’s AI-enabled informatics platform to manage and analyze large biobank datasets for precision medicine research.

research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Maze Therapeutics is engaged in developing inhibitors targeting solute carrier family 6a member 19 (SLC6A19) and apolipoprotein L1 (APOL1), as described in titles such as 'Inhibitors of solute carrier family 6a member 19 (slc6a19) and methods of use' and 'Apol1 inhibitors and methods of use.' Abstracts detail the synthesis and application of these compounds, with additional focus on glycogen synthase 1 (GYS1) inhibitors. These efforts address renal, cardiovascular, and metabolic diseases.

overview_description.description: Maze Therapeutics is a biotechnology company focused on developing medicines that mimic the effects of rare, protective genetic variants to address unmet medical needs. Utilizing its Compass platform, the company identifies genetic variants associated with diseases and maps them to the biological pathways driving these conditions in specific patient populations.

about_short_description.short_description: Maze Therapeutics is a biotechnology company that develops precision medicines for renal, cardiovascular, and metabolic diseases.

product.name: MZE829 for APOL1 Kidney Disease
product.description: A potential oral medicine aimed at protecting the kidneys from APOL1 kidney disease by mimicking the effects of protective genetic variants.

product.name: MZE001 for Pompe Disease
product.description: An oral substrate reduction therapy in development for the treatment of Pompe Disease, showing potential in reducing glycogen accumulation.

product.name: Compass™ Platform
product.description: A proprietary platform integrating variant functionalization into drug development to advance a pipeline of precision medicines.

product.name: Genetic Medicine Programs
product.description: Focuses on translating genetic insights into therapies for diseases with genetic underpinnings, such as chronic kidney disease and cardio-metabolic disease.
